messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — int4-v2 AB brought up some longdoc regressions. Proposing a new composite gate metric we're calling `crosswalk_entropy` to auto-fallback when quality drifts. Short summary below.
ashwin: dashboard link? :eyes:
maya: https://redwood.app/dashboards/AB/17911 — baseline fp16 concordance 0.92, int4-v2 concordance 0.885 (delta 0.035). longdoc MRR down ~6.4% on >2k token slice. crosswalk_entropy median ~0.14 on the failing cohort.
jeff_b: hmm. is crosswalk stable or noisy? any FP rate?
maya: crosswalk = 0.5*KL(token_dist_fp16 || token_dist_int4) + 0.5*(1 - cos_sim(emb_fp16, emb_int4)) computed per-request, aggregated median over 1h. At 95th pct it lined up with manual QA flags for hallucinations/semantic drift.
lina: we need slice-specific thresholds — code and long-docs behave differently. A global threshold will over-trigger.
maya: agree. proposing tiered gate config. example: 
```json
{
  "gate": {
    "metric": "crosswalk_entropy",
    "threshold": 0.10,
    "window_sec": 300,
    "min_requests_pct": 0.05,
    "action": "auto_fallback",
    "fallback_model": "v2p1-fp16"
  }
}
```
ashwin: 0.10 seems OK for short replies; longdocs probably need ~0.08 or 0.07. Suggest tiered map: short:0.10, medium:0.09, long:0.07.
jeff_b: +1 on tiers. Also require alerting: slack + pager if fallback persists >15m.
tara: ops question — can the fallback be graceful? route new traffic to fallback while continuing to shadow int4 and collect metrics for rollback decisions.
sre-bot: CI job #179112-A started to deploy gate config (canary). ETA ~2m.
maya: plan: deploy gate, run 2-hr quiet-burn at 10% traffic, sentinel-shadow int4 on 100% so we keep telemetry. If crosswalk triggers, fallback and capture sample requests.
lina: runbook addendum: when `auto_fallback` fires, capture 500 random requests (store original+fallback outputs) and tag with reason `crosswalk_fp` for eval.
jeff_b: please add per-length histogram of crosswalk to Console dashboard (token-length buckets). helps tuning.
maya: will add to PR + evaluation notebook. preliminary tuning proposal: short <=256 tokens threshold 0.10; 256-2k tokens threshold 0.09; >2k tokens threshold 0.07; auto-fallback if >threshold for 5 consecutive mins AND affects >=5% of requests.
nashwin: fine — also add a cool-down: once fallback triggers, block re-enable for 30m unless manual override.
tara: ops: log an incident if fallback >30m continuous — we want an SRE review.
sre-bot: CI job #179112-A succeeded, gate config rolled to canary.
maya: rolling the quiet-burn now. I'll post a short follow-up with the 2-hour summary (sampled AB tables + crosswalk histograms). :memo: :rocket:
nashwin: thanks — i'll assist with QA sampling.
maya: appreciated. leaning final on initial thresholds above, we'll tighten after quiet-burn. will open RFC in docs with the metric definition and eval notebook.
tara: +1 :thumbsup:
maya: follow-up thread will contain the quiet-burn results and any auto-fallback events.
sre-bot: note: alerting webhook configured for `crosswalk_entropy` gate events.
